notes.title: Metamorphos Achievements & Patch Notes
notes.content:
Enjoying Metamorphos?  Then we have some exciting news for you!  An update to the game has just been made that gives the game 8 brand new achievements for you to hunt down!  Not only does the game now feature these new achievements, but we also have a host of patch notes to share:


Added a save system.
Final boss has been tuned to be even more enjoyable.
Fixed game-breaking bug where the final boss's animations would lock up.
Various bugs have been fixed.
Fixed an issue with in-game music.
Fixed a small typo.


Click here to download for free now!
